changelog: Bare Metal Restore no longer offers image backups that hold no data. UrBackup can mark an image complete after the transfer failed, leaving a zero-byte record that lists like any other backup but restores nothing — the worst possible thing to pick during an outage. Such backups are now withheld from the restore picker, with a warning saying how many were hidden and why, rather than a silently shortened list.

The API marks each image backup with a `restorable` flag (non-zero size and the image file actually present on disk). Backup history still shows the failed attempts, so a broken backup chain stays visible instead of disappearing.
Includes 3.2.108: fixed VHD export failing with 'decompress-file exited 3'.
Includes 3.2.105-3.2.107: user roles scoped to customers (issue #21), migrations shipped through the update channel, Bare Metal Restore scoped per endpoint.
